## SECTION


```{r}
#| label: fig-example-ace-regression-filled
#| fig-cap: "Example ACE-style ggplot figure with matched confidence bands."
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4.5


dat <- tibble(
  x = rep(seq(0, 10, length.out = 40), 2),
  group = rep(c("Group A", "Group B"), each = 40),
  y = case_when(
    group == "Group A" ~ 2.5 + 0.55 * x + rnorm(40, 0, 0.8),
    group == "Group B" ~ 1.5 + 0.95 * x + rnorm(40, 0, 0.8)
  )
)


ggplot(dat, aes(x = x, y = y, color = group, fill = group)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.2, alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    linewidth = 1.15,
    alpha = 0.16
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Group A" = ace_blue,
      "Group B" = ace_purple
    )
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Group A" = ace_blue,
      "Group B" = ace_purple
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Example Regression Figure",
    subtitle = "Two fitted regression lines with semi-transparent confidence bands",
    x = "Predictor",
    y = "Outcome",
    caption = "Note. Simulated data shown for ACE figure style development."
  ) +
  theme_ace()
```
